No, I haven't felt a loss of interest. I still enjoy meeting new people, trying different foods, and going to the gym to keep my energy up.

No, I haven't felt down, depressed, or hopeless over the past two weeks. I've been doing really good and keeping my energy up with my workouts.
Over the past two weeks, have you had trouble falling or staying asleep?
No, I haven't had any trouble falling or staying asleep recently. I usually fall asleep easily after my evening workout and wake up feeling refreshed.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt tired or lacked energy?
No, I haven't felt tired or lacked energy over the past two weeks. In fact, I've been working out regularly to keep my energy levels going.
Over the past two weeks, have you had a poor appetite or been overeating?
No, my appetite has been completely normal over the past two weeks. I'm eating regularly and haven't experienced any urges to overeat or skip meals.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt bad about yourself or like a failure?
No, I haven't felt like a failure recently. I feel confident in my ability to handle people and stay calm in high-pressure situations.
Over the past two weeks, have you had trouble concentrating on tasks like reading or working?
No, I haven't had trouble concentrating on tasks like reading or working over the past two weeks. I feel focused and calm, especially since I've been working out regularly to manage my stress.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt slowed down in your movements or speech?
No, I haven't felt slowed down in my movements or speech. I actually feel quite energetic and keep my energy level going by working out regularly.
